item.title: Federal judge recuses self from lawsuit filed by former law clerk - Marianas Variety News &amp; Views
item.description: CHIEF Judge Ramona V. Manglona of the District Court for the NMI has disqualified herself from presiding over a federal lawsuit filed by a former Superior Court law clerk who alleges that his now‑overturned criminal prosecution for sexual assault was retaliatory. Judge Manglona recused herself under 28 U.S.C. § 455(a), stating that her impartiality might reasonably be questioned.

item.title: CBP: China among countries with lowest overstay rates in FY 2024 - Marianas Variety News &amp; Views
item.description: CHINA is among the countries with the lowest overstay rates, according to U.S. Customs and Border Protection’s fiscal year 2024 report to Congress.

item.title: Rangamar’s assault conviction overturned; case remanded to new judge - Marianas Variety News &amp; Views
item.description: THE NMI Supreme Court has vacated the conviction of Sergio M. Rangamar and ordered a new trial, ruling that the Superior Court judge who presided over his case should have recused herself because of her prior involvement with a key witness in the Drug Court Program.

item.title: Child meth exposure now a criminal offense - Marianas Variety News &amp; Views
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang last week signed House Bill 24‑26 into law, criminalizing the act of exposing children to methamphetamine.

item.title: Long-running legal matter ends with dismissal of Torres charges - Marianas Variety News &amp; Views
item.description: “After six months reviewing the case, with the benefit of eight years of experience in financial investigations, my assessment is that the evidence is not sufficient to prove criminal violations. However, Mr. Torres agreed to repay $23,745 for the additional cost of premium airfare upgrades.”

item.title: US expected to send thousands more soldiers to Middle East - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: WASHINGTON (Reuters) — The Pentagon is expected to send ​thousands of soldiers from the U.S. Army's elite 82nd Airborne Division to the Middle East, two people familiar with the ‌matter told Reuters on Tuesday, adding to a massive U.S. military buildup even as President Donald Trump talks about a possible deal with Tehran to end the war.

item.title: South Korean alleged 'drug lord' running ring from Philippine jail extradited - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: SEOUL (Reuters) — South Korean police on Wednesday took into custody an alleged "drug lord" accused of running a narcotics ring in the country from ​a Philippine prison, officials said on Wednesday.

item.title: Sewer odor in Sadog Tasi, Puerto Rico from March 27 to 30 - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: (Commonwealth Utilities Corporation) — A noticeable sewage odor may be present in the Sadog Tasi and Puerto Rico areas from Friday, March 27, 2026, to Monday, March 30, 2026.

item.title: Saipan Chamber of Commerce Career Pathways Internship Program concludes successful year - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: (SCC) — The Saipan Chamber of Commerce extends its sincere appreciation to the Public School System for its continued collaboration and support in making the Career Pathways Internship Program possible for students across the CNMI.

item.title: Five-course meal spotlights local delicacies at Jubilee event - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: MEMBERS of the public enjoyed a five-course meal featuring local delicacies at the Commonwealth Jubilee’s “Heritage on a Plate” event held Monday at the Garapan Fishing Base.

item.title: $50K re-appropriated to improve roads, facilities, and tourism sites on Saipan - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang on Friday approved House Bill 24-46, re-appropriating $50,000 in developer infrastructure tax collections for projects to enhance tourist destinations on Saipan.

item.title: Descendants of WWII veterans retrace Saipan, Tinian battle sites - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: DESCENDANTS of World War II veterans are retracing the battle sites of Saipan and Tinian this month as part of a series of heritage tours. The program has already brought more than 100 visitors to the Northern Marianas, with the final group scheduled to arrive on March 30.

item.title: CEC: Funding shortfall could jeopardize 2026 elections - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: THE Commonwealth Election Commission is requesting $420,000 for the 2026 general election.

item.title: Torres rebuts AG criticism of Camacho nomination - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: ATTORNEY Robert T. Torres sharply rejected Attorney General Edward Manibusan’s criticism of Associate Judge Joseph N. Camacho’s nomination as presiding judge, calling the objections “patently offensive to the rule of law” as senators prepare for a second round of public hearings on judicial nominees.

item.title: Covenant’s legacy, limits take center stage at forum - Marianas Variety News & Views
item.description: THE 50th anniversary of the Covenant between the Northern Mariana Islands and the United States was marked March 24 with a panel discussion at the American Memorial Park indoor theater, the centerpiece of the third day of the Commonwealth Jubilee.
